history.summary: A freehold 1BR (474 sqft) at The Verandah Residences, D05 (Pasir Panjang), $948K / $2,000 psf — below the $2,039 median on a 30-txn series, but the resale CAGR is a weak ~2.4%. Freehold and sub-$1M quantum are pluses; the low appreciation rate and shoebox format hold it to Neutral.
history.rating_rationale: Freehold, $948K (broad buyer pool for a shoebox), and listed $2,000 psf below the $2,039 median give a small cushion on a serviceable 30-txn series. But ~2.4% resale CAGR is the weakest reliable rate in the batch, and a 474 sqft 1BR is a niche resale. D05/One-North and Greater Southern Waterfront proximity support rental demand. Net: a steady freehold income unit, not an appreciation play.
red_flags: ~2.4% resale CAGR — low appreciation even for freehold RCR
474 sqft shoebox — niche resale, no family appeal
catalysts: Freehold under $1M — rare, keeps buyer pool broad
One-North employment + Greater Southern Waterfront (D4/5) transformation nearby
